headline: Housing is moving further away from wages: the salary gap between regions is 10,000 euros a year; the housing gap is 383,000 euros
summary: A regional comparison in Spain shows housing prices differ by 392.80% between regions while wages differ by 41.20%. Down payments range from 29,241 to 144,099 euros.
why: Housing affordability shapes mortgage demand, household spending and the outlook for Spanish banks and real estate developers.
